content.rendered:
HERE IS JUST A SAMPLE OF THE LAYOUT FOR A WEDDING TO HELP YOU WITH YOUR SPECIAL DAY AND GIVE YOU SOME IDEAS !
(Please note each wedding is unique and we play customised music for the types of music the Bride & Groom requests.) 

Wedding Event Schedule & Playlist

Event Overview

  • Location: Penthouse Suite

  • Service Hours: 5:15 PM – 11:15 PM

The Timeline

Time Event Music / Notes
5:15 PM – 6:30 PM Ceremony Processional, Wedding Party March, and Recessional
6:30 PM – 7:00 PM Cocktail Hour Grand Entrance (Introductions from list)
7:00 PM – 8:00 PM Dinner Service Wedding-style Jazz
8:00 PM – 8:15 PM Toasts Best Man and Maid of Honor
8:15 PM – 8:25 PM Slide Show Background media
8:25 PM – 8:40 PM Specialty Dances First Dance, Parents, and Bridal Party
8:40 PM – 9:05 PM Traditions Garter Toss and Bouquet Toss
9:05 PM – 9:15 PM Cake Cutting Cake serving and parent presentation
9:15 PM – 11:10 PM Open Dance Floor Party favorites and guest requests
11:10 PM – 11:15 PM Last Dance Grand Finale

Key Songs & Formalities

  • First Dance: Unchained Melody – Righteous Brothers

  • Father/Daughter Dance: Unforgettable – Nat King Cole & Natalie Cole

  • Mother/Son Dance: A Song for Mama – Boyz II Men

  • Bridal Party Dance: We Are Family – Sister Sledge

  • Garter Toss: Legs – ZZ Top

  • Bouquet Toss: Like a Virgin – Madonna

  • Cake Cutting: Cut The Cake – Average White Band

Music Library Highlights

Essential Dance Classics

  • Celebration – Kool & The Gang

  • 1999 – Prince

  • YMCA – Village People

  • Shout – The Isley Brothers/Dynatones

  • The Twist – Chubby Checker

  • Whoomp! (There It Is) – Tag Team

Slow Dances

  • Could I Have This Dance – Anne Murray

  • I Could Not Ask For More – Sara Evans

  • Nothing’s Gonna Change My Love For You – Glenn Medeiros

Interactive & Games

  • Themes: Mission Impossible, The Pink Panther, The Stripper

  • Group Dances: The Hokey Pokey, The Chicken Dance, Macarena, Hand Jive

Pro Tip: We offer optional interactive games involving the newlyweds and guests during dinner or cake service to keep the energy high and ensure the celebration continues seamlessly throughout the evening.

Wedding Party Entrance

During Introductions After the Announcement
Main Title – Father of the Bride It Had to Be You – Harry Connick Jr.
Southampton – Titanic Sea of Love – Honeydrippers
Theme from Star Wars Celebration – Kool and the Gang
WWF Intro Music Rock & Roll All Night – KISS
Let’s Get Ready To Rumble You’re My First, Last & Everything – Barry White
Hot In Here – Nelly Signed, Sealed & Delivered – Stevie Wonder

ACTIVITIES AND GAMES
*Sing part of a song, give a toast, or tell a story to get the bride and groom to kiss
*Sing part of a song to be allowed to go to the buffet table
*Blindfold the guy who caught garter before he removes the garter from the leg of the lady who caught the bouquet
*Married couples dance and we find out who has been married the longest at the reception
*Blindfold the bride and she guesses which arm muscle belongs to the groom
*Blindfold the groom and he feels hands or calves and guesses which one belongs to the bride
*The bride moves an egg through the grooms pants
*The bride and groom eat something and come together for a kiss
*The groom pays the bride a compliment for each step he takes toward her
*The bride is blindfolded and has to find the money on the groom
*Guests have to do what the bride and groom say to get a personal item back
*”Ex-boyfriends” and “ex-girlfriends” return the “keys” to the bride and groom’s apartments
*Musical chairs
*The groom guesses which lipstick mark belongs to the bride
*The groom is blindfolded and has to walk without knocking down the wine bottles
*The bride has to catch the cherry
*Guests need to get pencils, which are hanging on strings behind them, in the bottles
